title: Water Baptism
description: Join us at the river as we celebrate new life in Christ. Bring a towel, a change of clothes, and invite your friends and family to witness this special step of faith!

title: Annual General Meeting
description: Our yearly AGM where we review the financials, discuss the vision for the upcoming year, and vote on trust board members. All members are encouraged to attend.

title: Mega Group
description: This week: More Proverbs. Come along for Worship - Study - Prayer - Fellowship
